links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated knee osteoarthritis patient education (FKGL, FRES, Ateşman, Çakır-Demir)
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 FKGL 9.6 ± 0.9 vs Gonarthrosis Advisor 7.8 ± 0.7; FRES 46.7 vs 54.3; both above plain-language grade targets, guideline-tuned model better (all P<.001)
links.quote: Readability metrics favored the Gonarthrosis Advisor across all indices: lower FKGL (7.8 ± 0.7 vs. 9.6 ± 0.9) and higher FRES (54.3 ± 3.4 vs. 46.7 ± 3.7), Ateşman (92.0 ± 4.2 vs. 84.3 ± 4.9), and Çakır-Demir (111.7 ± 5.1 vs. 106.9 ± 5.4) scores (all P <.001).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLM with guideline-based content and reinforcement learning to improve quality of patient education material

screen.reason: The study compares a general LLM with a domain-specifically fine-tuned LLM (Gonarthrosis Advisor) for patient education quality and readability. Comparing a newly fine-tuned model against a base LLM is considered model development/benchmarking rather than testing an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
